items.text: Smoother co-op: fewer crashes, freezes, and disconnects when joining and playing together
Better multi-controller support on PC: two or more controllers, including non-Xbox controllers, now work without reconnecting (Steam and Epic Games Store)
DualSense fix on PC: playing with two DualSense controllers connected now works from launch (Epic Games Store)
Steadier footing: fixes for spots where heroes could fall through the map or get stuck
Visual polish: fixes for fairy colors, Fiona's cutscene animations, lighting, and textures
Photo Mode polish: the camera stays in bounds and keeps its speed during Fiona's slow time

notes.title: Bug Fixes (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation, Xbox)

items.text: The fairies in jars in Level 1 now show their colors.
Fixed a building in Level 3 where players could slip out of bounds.
Fixed Human Shrek falling through the map in Level 9.
Prince Charming now stays in view and returns to the arena correctly in Level 11.
The Mirror no longer passes through Fiona's and Shrek's heads in the final cutscene of Level 11.
Fiona's eyes now display and animate correctly during the first and fifth cutscenes of Level 11.
Characters can now move in the Scrambled Eggs minigame in Level 6 when Left Stick Sensitivity is set below 65%.
Fixed bombs and in-game platforms moving too fast during Hero Time in Level 8 when playing at 144 FPS.
Photo Mode now stays inside the level at the start of Level 10 and near the giant crack.
Fiona's slow time ability no longer affects camera speed in Photo Mode.
Online features now successfully connect when re-establishing internet connectivity after launching the game.
The "Connection Lost" message now clearly tells players to return to the main menu.
Hosts no longer see a "You have lost connection with host" message when another player leaves.
The pause menu now stays in sync for everyone in multiplayer when one player unpauses while another is still choosing an option.
Hero Time now stays in sync in multiplayer when one player opens a menu while another keeps playing.
Joining players now hear audio and see button prompts during Fiona's Hero Time in Level 1 multiplayer.
Improved stability when joining a game during the Lil Red cutscene in Level 1.
Fixed a freeze when using the magic mirror in Level 1's fairy area with 3 or 4 players.
Improved stability when joining a game during the second Mouse Gate cutscene in Level 2.
Joining players now keep up with the host in Level 6 multiplayer.
Improved stability for hosts in Level 7 multiplayer when another player finishes Hero Time while the host is paused.
Fixed Puss in Boots floating in the air while idle during the rope walk in Level 10 multiplayer.
The co-op party display no longer covers the Troll's health bar in the three troll battle in Level 11.
Players joining during Hero Time no longer see a "kicked" message on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Steam Specific Fixes
Fixed players getting stuck in a rock at the double saw puzzle in Level 5.
Characters can now walk onto the wooden platforms in Level 7.
Fixed characters falling out of bounds between the wall and the gear in Level 7.
The target in Level 8 is now easier to hit.
Fixed players falling through the ground during Hero Time in Level 9.
Frogs in Level 9 now react to Gingy's cookie even when it lands near the edges.
Fixed yellow frogs freezing when a cookie is thrown at them in Level 9.
Certain snapshots on level 8 now unlock successfully after completing their objectives.
In Progress
These issues are planned fixes being worked on for a future update
We're updating Lil' Red's character model and HUD icon to give her a fresh new look.
Online play on Steam currently needs an Epic Games account, and we're exploring options to make signing in with one optional.
